title: MemorySpacesFreezeResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "status": "frozen", "pending_receipts": int, "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.spaces.freeze (§7.3): REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_AUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
